sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Llefelys (Llevelys) is a Welsh hero or god. In Welsh myth this king ruled the Continent while his brother Lludd ruled Britain. Llefelys came to Lludd aid to free Britain from the three plagues. He is a king shaped by the frame of the old Welsh tales, standing beside the British ruler Lludd as an ally across the sea.

okr.objective: Give the lesser role of the Welsh king Llefelys.
